brief.originalRequest: Export all filtered rows as CSV and keep the interface usable during export.

requirements.text: Export all filtered rows, not only the visible page.
Keep user interaction usable while export runs.

components.name: CSV serializer
components.responsibility: Produce a CSV download for the filtered results.
components.mechanism: Serialize visible table rows synchronously and download the CSV.

components.name: Export indicator
components.responsibility: Keep the interface usable during export.
components.mechanism: Set exporting=true before serialization and show a spinner.

relationships.contract: The indicator is visible and interaction continues while synchronous serialization runs.

evidence.content: Table.rows contains only the current page of filtered results.
onExport sets exporting=true, serializes Table.rows in a synchronous loop, and then sets exporting=false. No yield or worker is specified.
